data: {"result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":true}},"serverInfo":{"name":"ask-besty-mcp","version":"0.1.0"},"instructions":"Read-only tools over one Besty account (the token's tenant). Routing guide:
- export_* tools: bulk data (reservations, messages, reviews, calendar, ...) with filters, column selection, and an aggregation grammar; large results return a presigned file URL. Start with describe_export_schemas for columns.
- list_*/get_* tools: the account's CONFIGURATION â what Besty is set up to do. Use these for "what will Besty do when X?" (list_workflows -> get_workflows), "what messages do guests get?" (list_journeys -> get_journey), "what are guests told about X?" (list_pages -> get_page), and what upsells are configured (list_custom_upsells, get_upsell_settings).
- compute_* and summarize_upsell_revenue: canonical metric numbers (occupancy, response time, upsell revenue) â prefer these over recomputing from raw exports.
- Upsell funnel: export_upsell_offers = offers SENT to guests; export_upsell_events = holds/purchases/revenue. No FK between them.
- Resolve listing names to ids via list_listings (and groupings via list_listing_sets) before passing listing ids anywhere.
- Tool availability reflects this connection's granted scopes; tools outside the grant are not listed."},"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1}
